summary: The United States and Iran are engaged in direct military exchanges, with the U.S. targeting IRGC mining forces on Larak Island (killing 3) and Iran firing missiles at U.S. positions in Jordan. President Trump has vowed to "hit them hard" in response, while considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to degrade Iranian radar and missile capabilities. Iranian Armed Forces General Staff warned that Middle Eastern states hosting U.S. forces will be targeted, and CENTCOM rejected IRGC claims of a supertanker hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
key_points: President Trump and senior aides are considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding radar and missile capabilities used to attack ships, according to three U.S. officials. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6651)

CENTCOM stated no ships have hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz following an IRGC claim that a supertanker struck two mines, calling it misinformation intended to intimidate commercial shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/9257)
President Trump told Fox News the U.S. will respond to the Iranian missile attack on U.S. forces overnight, saying "We're going to hit them hard." (Source: @shin_persian/9254)

Iran's Armed Forces General Staff warned that it will target countries in the Middle East whose airspace or territory the U.S. uses to attack it, threatening a heavier response than the previous night's attack. (Source: @VahidOnline/78119)
Israel's Air Force struck a target in the area between the towns of Mayfadoun and Zawtar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, per Lebanese reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134488)

IDF forces eliminated Omar Muhammad Rushdi Saraj, a Hamas supply and maintenance platoon commander in Gaza City, in the Sabra area, along with another Hamas military wing operative. (Source: @New_security8200/203507)
The IRGC claimed it shot down an MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, the second such downing in 24 hours. (Source: @kianmeli1/91302)
Iran's armed forces stated an Iranian missile penetrated U.S. air defenses at Muwaffaq al-Salti Air Base in Jordan and hit an aircraft hangar, per satellite imagery. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88893)

sections.executive_summary: The U.S. and Iran are now in direct military confrontation following mutual strikes on Larak Island and U.S. positions in Jordan. President Trump has pledged a hard U.S. response while considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to degrade Iranian capabilities. CENTCOM rejected IRGC claims of mining incidents in the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran's General Staff warned it will strike any Middle Eastern state hosting U.S. forces used against Iran.

points:
The IRGC claimed it shot down an MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, the second such downing reported within 24 hours. (Source: @kianmeli1/91302)

Iran's Armed Forces General Staff warned in a Monday statement that it will target Middle Eastern countries whose airspace or territory the U.S. uses to attack Iran, threatening a heavier response than the previous night's strikes. The statement followed President Trump's announcement of a harsh U.S. response to Iran's missile attack on U.S. forces in Jordan. (Source: @VahidOnline/78119)

Iranian President Pezeshkian addressed the SCO summit, stating Iran has offered initiatives to deepen trade and energy cooperation, while slamming U.S.-Israeli attacks against Iran as violations of the UN Charter and international law. He claimed Iran inflicted a heavy defeat on the U.S. and Israel in the recent imposed war. (Source: @presstv/204995)

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi held talks with counterparts from other SCO member states on the sidelines of the summit. (Source: @presstv/204990)

CENTCOM officially rejected the IRGC's claim that a supertanker struck two mines while transiting the southern route of the Strait of Hormuz, stating no ships have hit mines there and labeling the claim as IRGC misinformation aimed at intimidating commercial shipping. (Source: @VahidOnline/78109)

Iran's dollar exchange rate surpassed 211,000 toman on Monday (9 Shahrivar) amid escalating military tensions with the U.S., with gold prices also experiencing a sharp surge. (Source: @mamlekate/104279)

IDF Southern Command forces eliminated Omar Muhammad Rushdi Saraj, who served as the supply and maintenance platoon commander for Hamas in Gaza City, in an operation in the Sabra area of Gaza. In the same operation, another Hamas military wing operative who promoted terror attacks against IDF forces and Israeli civilians was also targeted. (Source: @New_security8200/203507)

The IDF stated the eliminated terrorists had been working to restore Hamas capabilities in systematic violation of the ceasefire, and IDF forces remain deployed in the area per the agreement and will continue to act to remove any threat. (Source: @New_security8200/203507)

Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu announced a security agreement signed with Greece, calling it one of the largest in the country's history and a direct continuation of the Eastern Mediterranean alliance established a decade ago with Greece and Cyprus. He framed the deal as evidence of Israel's defense and technological industries' capabilities. (Source: @almogboker78/18089)

Israel's Ambassador to the UN Danny Danon met with his Venezuelan counterpart for the first time following the renewal of consular relations, with both discussing "strengthening relations." (Source: @N12chat/224345)

Residents of Jerusalem and Maale Adumim were notified of possible disruptions and interruptions in water supply due to disruptions at desalination facilities. The National Cyber Directorate clarified this was not a cyber incident and urged residents to avoid watering gardens and washing vehicles to conserve water. (Source: @yediotnews25/134484)

IDF forces operating under Southern Command eliminated Omar Muhammad Rushdi Saraj, a Hamas supply and maintenance platoon commander in Gaza City, in a strike in the Sabra area. Saraj had been managing the supply of weapons to Hamas terrorists in Gaza City. (Source: @yediotnews25/134489)

In the same operation, another Hamas military wing operative who had been promoting terror attacks against IDF forces and Israeli citizens and working to restore Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire was also struck. (Source: @New_security8200/203507)
Intensive reconnaissance drone flights by Israeli forces were reported over Gaza City skies. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387907)

Israeli Air Force forces struck a target in the area between the towns of Mayfadoun and Zawtar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, according to Lebanese reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134488)

Explosions from war remnants were reported in the town of Habbush in the Nabatieh district. (Source: @redlinkleb/39808)

Artillery shelling was reported in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, with a live map referenced for the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/39834)

Strikes in Lebanon continue, according to Israeli media reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134487)

Satellite imagery reportedly showed an Iranian missile penetrating U.S. air defenses at Muwaffaq al-Salti Air Base in Jordan and striking an aircraft hangar. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88893)

The Iraqi Oil Ministry officially denied that the sanctioned tanker "BINARY STAR" had docked at Iraqi ports, confirming that its AIS tracking signal had been spoofed. There was speculation that Iran may be successfully exporting its own oil under the guise of Iraqi shipments while the U.S. and Tankertrackers believe it is Iraqi oil. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387892)

A widespread power outage affected most areas of Baghdad following a strike by private generator owners protesting the government's failure to provide them with fuel oil. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387902)

Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan agreed to establish a permanent secretariat in Saudi Arabia under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, with Pakistan providing the first secretary-general for a three-year term. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6647)

Missile launches were reported from Yemen toward Saudi-aligned militia concentrations in Mocha. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387893)

key_developments: President Trump and senior aides are considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding radar and missile capabilities used to attack ships, with the plan described as "mowing the lawn" to reduce risk to oil tankers, U.S. Navy ships, and Air Force aircraft. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6651)

CENTCOM rejected the IRGC's claim that a supertanker struck two mines in the Strait of Hormuz, stating no ships have hit mines there and labeling it IRGC misinformation aimed at intimidating commercial shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/9257)

President Trump told Fox News the U.S. will deliver a harsh response to Iran's overnight missile attack on U.S. forces, stating "We're going to hit them hard" and "There will be a response." (Source: @shin_persian/9254)

Iran's Armed Forces General Staff warned Middle Eastern countries hosting U.S. forces used against Iran will be targeted, threatening a heavier response than the previous night's strikes that hit U.S. positions in Jordan. (Source: @VahidOnline/78119)

IDF forces eliminated Hamas supply and maintenance platoon commander Omar Muhammad Rushdi Saraj in Gaza City's Sabra area, along with another Hamas military wing operative working to restore Hamas capabilities. (Source: @New_security8200/203507)
Israeli Air Force struck a target between the towns of Mayfadoun and Zawtar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, with artillery shelling also reported in Nabatieh al-Fawqa. (Source: @yediotnews25/134488)
The IRGC claimed it shot down an MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, marking the second such downing within 24 hours. (Source: @kianmeli1/91302)
sections.threat_assessment: The U.S.-Iran conflict has escalated from proxy exchanges to direct military confrontation, with both sides striking each other's forces and making explicit threats of further escalation. Iran's General Staff warning to target any Middle Eastern state hosting U.S. forces represents a significant broadening of the threat envelope, potentially placing multiple regional U.S. basing states at risk. The IRGC's claim of shooting down a second MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz within 24 hours, combined with CENTCOM's rejection of IRGC mining claims, suggests intensifying Iranian disinformation and kinetic activity in this critical maritime chokepoint. Israeli operations against Hamas infrastructure in Gaza, including the elimination of a supply and maintenance commander, indicate continued IDF efforts to degrade Hamas's reconstitution capabilities despite ceasefire arrangements.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are responding with diplomatic and defensive measures amid escalating tensions. Prime Netanyahu announced a major security agreement with Greece framed as a continuation of the Eastern Mediterranean alliance with Greece and Cyprus, signaling continued Israeli regional coalition-building. Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan agreed to establish a permanent secretariat under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, with Pakistan providing the first secretary-general for three years, indicating formalization of a Sunni Muslim nuclear-armed security architecture. Iran's Pezeshkian used the SCO platform to denounce U.S.-Israeli attacks and claim Iranian victory, while pursuing trade and energy cooperation initiatives with member states.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple unverified claims require careful sourcing assessment: the IRGC's supertanker mining incident claim has been officially denied by CENTCOM, while the IRGC's MQ-9 shoot-down claim has not yet been confirmed by U.S. sources. Satellite imagery reportedly showing Iranian missile penetration of U.S. air defenses at Muwaffaq al-Salti Air Base in Jordan and damage to an aircraft hangar remains to be independently verified. The U.S. plan to conduct limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to degrade Iranian radar and missile capabilities, described as "mowing the lawn" by a U.S. official, appears to have been in development prior to the recent escalation and may now receive presidential approval. Iran's economic indicators show the dollar exceeding 211,000 toman amid the military tensions, suggesting significant market reaction to the conflict.
